title_zh: 多迷走神經研究所 10–11 月免費線上活動：Deb Dana 問答、Porges 談言語發展
title_en: Polyvagal Institute free online community events Oct–Nov 2026
summary_zh: 註冊為 501(c)(3) 非營利組織的 Polyvagal Institute 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月有五場免費 Zoom 活動，包括 11/6 共同創辦人 Deb Dana 的問答，以及 11/14 Stephen Porges 與國際講者討論言語、語言發展與自律神經系統的 90 分鐘座談。報名即可在活動後收到錄影（Deb Dana 場錄影只開放兩週）。
summary_en: The Polyvagal Institute, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, hosts five free Zoom community events in Oct–Nov 2026, including a Q&A with co-founder Deb Dana (Nov 6) and a 90-minute conversation with Stephen Porges and international panelists on speech, language development and the autonomic nervous system (Nov 14). Registrants receive recordings afterwards.
evidence_note: 培訓課程資訊，非研究證據。
caution: 屬免費社群活動，頁面未列 CE；多迷走神經理論的臨床應用宜與其他實證文獻一併評估，不宜當作單一解釋框架。
brief_zh: 10/12 身體覺察正念練習（45 分鐘）、10/26 治療性瑜伽作者講座
11/6 Deb Dana 問答、11/10 Simone Saunders 作者講座
11/14 Porges 與國際講者談言語、語言發展與自律神經
全部免費，皆為美東時間中午前後；報名者可收錄影
brief_en: Oct 12 embodied mindfulness; Oct 26 therapeutic yoga author talk
Nov 6 Q&A with Deb Dana; Nov 10 author talk with Simone Saunders
Nov 14 Porges panel on speech, language and the ANS
All free, around noon ET; recordings sent to registrants

related.title_zh: Classroom WISE：免費自學的學校心理健康素養課程
related.title_en: Classroom WISE free school mental health literacy course
related.summary_zh: Classroom WISE 由美國 MHTTC 網絡與馬里蘭大學醫學院 National Center for School Mental Health 合作開發，是免費的三部分訓練包，包括自學線上課程、影片庫與資源集。內容涵蓋心理健康素養、辨識學生困擾、降溫技巧、創傷知情與包容的課室環境，對象是 K-12 教師、學校人員與學校心理健康專業人員。
related.summary_en: Classroom WISE, developed by the MHTTC Network with the National Center for School Mental Health at the University of Maryland School of Medicine, is a free three-part package with a self-paced online course, video library and resource collection. It covers mental health literacy, recognizing student distress, de-escalation, trauma-informed and inclusive classrooms for K-12 educators and school staff.

training.provider: MHTTC Network、National Center for School Mental Health（University of Maryland School of Medicine）
training.format: 自學線上課程（含影片庫與資源集）

related.title_zh: Pat Ogden 免費錄影講座：感覺動作心理治療談創傷下的復原力
related.title_en: Free Pat Ogden webinar on resilience amid trauma
related.summary_zh: Leading Edge Seminars 與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute（SPI）、SensorimotorItalia.it 合作，免費公開 Pat Ogden 與 Rebeca Farca 的錄影講座「Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events」。內容介紹如何協助長期處於壓力與威脅下的案主，並附講義、給案主用的 PEACE protocol 與給臨床人員的 SPI protocol 可下載。
related.summary_en: Leading Edge Seminars, with the Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute and SensorimotorItalia.it, offers a free recorded webinar by Pat Ogden and Rebeca Farca, 'Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events'. It shows how to help clients living with long-term stress and threat, with a downloadable handout, a PEACE protocol for clients and an SPI protocol for clinicians.

training.provider: Leading Edge Seminars（與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute 合作）

related.title_zh: 免費網上研討會：用身體工具建立獲得性安全依附
related.title_en: Free Webinar: Creating Earned Secure Attachment with Somatic Tools
related.summary_zh: 這場免費線上工作坊教治療師用身體取向框架，幫助個案把安全依附變成身體經驗。課程不只談理論，會帶體驗式練習。適合處理發展性創傷與不安全依附的臨床工作者。
related.summary_en: Free one-hour virtual workshop (14 Oct 2026, 12–1pm ET) on helping clients move from insight to embodied secure attachment using three body-based techniques; 1 CE hour for several US licences.

training.provider: Phoenix Center for Experiential Trauma Therapy
training.ce_credits: 1 CE Hour for NBCC, PA SW, LPC, LMFT, and Psychologists
